parameters.formTitle: AI Job Search & Resume Tailoring Profile
parameters.formDescription: Configure your target roles, skills, locations, match threshold, and resume source without rebuilding the workflow.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO users (email, full_name, phone, schedule_enabled)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
  phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, users.phone),
  schedule_enabled = EXCLUDED.schedule_enabled,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, email, full_name, schedule_enabled;

INSERT INTO user_preferences (
  user_id, target_job_titles, years_of_experience, technical_skills,
  preferred_locations, work_modes, work_authorization, employment_types,
  salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, seniority_levels,
  preferred_companies, excluded_companies, notice_period,
  resume_output_format, notification_method, notification_target,
  search_frequency, max_jobs_per_run, min_match_score
) VALUES (
  $1, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7, $8::jsonb,
  $9, $10, $11, $12::jsonb, $13::jsonb, $14::jsonb, $15,
  $16, $17, $18, $19, $20, $21
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
  target_job_titles = EXCLUDED.target_job_titles,
  years_of_experience = EXCLUDED.years_of_experience,
  technical_skills = EXCLUDED.technical_skills,
  preferred_locations = EXCLUDED.preferred_locations,
  work_modes = EXCLUDED.work_modes,
  work_authorization = EXCLUDED.work_authorization,
  employment_types = EXCLUDED.employment_types,
  salary_min = EXCLUDED.salary_min,
  salary_max = EXCLUDED.salary_max,
  salary_currency = EXCLUDED.salary_currency,
  seniority_levels = EXCLUDED.seniority_levels,
  preferred_companies = EXCLUDED.preferred_companies,
  excluded_companies = EXCLUDED.excluded_companies,
  notice_period = EXCLUDED.notice_period,
  resume_output_format = EXCLUDED.resume_output_format,
  notification_method = EXCLUDED.notification_method,
  notification_target = EXCLUDED.notification_target,
  search_frequency = EXCLUDED.search_frequency,
  max_jobs_per_run = EXCLUDED.max_jobs_per_run,
  min_match_score = EXCLUDED.min_match_score,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, user_id, min_match_score, max_jobs_per_run, search_frequency;
